experiment.title: Complete the clean baseline refresh
experiment.implementation: Two-launch writing baseline runner exists; prior second launch was rejected for new swap. Refresh remains incomplete.
experiment.only_change: No settings change: depth 3, eight helper workers, Tensor API on, F16 4K cache.
experiment.hypothesis: A clean repeat establishes current comparison conditions.
prerequisites: Explicit testing go-ahead for any --run command
Offline validation receipt matches current sources
Quiet host; leave unrelated VM/build work alone
proof: Two accepted launches with identical prompts/settings/hashes
Monitor healthy; owned server exits; zero new swap
128-token synthetic/code/prose/Chinese replies and cached task checks
stop_if: Unexpected quality failure or new swap
experiment.limits: Historical single-launch numbers are references. A refresh provides no optimization gain by itself.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
